source: CardInsider extraction pipeline (v3.1.1 baseline) + redemption_rules transform v1
_note: Nine cards re-sourced from the issuers' own T&C / MITC / fee PDFs on 2026-08-20. Every number written or changed carries source_url + source_quote + source_fetched_on + an honest confidence ON THE ROW THAT HOLDS THE NUMBER; a card-level stamp is never treated as evidence for a rule. Four cards shipped base_reward_rate = 0.0 alongside multiplier rules, which made every rate on them compute to zero and rank them last on every purchase; all four now carry the issuer's real base earn and a matching base rule. Flipkart Super Elite — the fifth zero-base card — is deliberately untouched: its SuperCoin rupee value is an aggregator estimate that Flipkart itself disclaims. No rule_name was edited, because the app keys users' saved cap progress on that string, so three corrected rules still carry names quoting the superseded rate and the gate reports them on purpose.
